newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-QBE shares rise after 1st qtr result.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-QBE shares rise after 1st qtr result.

text.p: The shares of QBE Insurance Group Ltd firmed on Tuesday afternoon after the company reported a net profit of A$28.5 million for the September quarter compared to A$28.0 million a year earlier and said it saw further profit growth in the 1996/97 financial year.
At 2.30 p.m. (0330 GMT), QBE shares were 15 cents higher at A$6.70 on turnover of 169,961 shares. The stock was trading at A$6.47 before the result was released.
QBE's managing director John Cloney later told reporters the company expected profit growth in the year to June 30, 1997 of between 15 and 20 percent. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
